title: 特朗普返美后表态：台湾那谁“台独很危险”！美国不想为台湾开战！｜新闻特写20260517
executive_summary: The video discusses Trump's statement on Taiwan, mentioning '台独很危险' (Taiwan independence is very dangerous) and that the US does not want to go to war for Taiwan.
